title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - DataLicense
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/DataLicense. The constraints that apply to the data consumers accessing and using the datasets in the Data Product.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DataLicense'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

odrlProfile.description: Property. The identifier(s) of an ODRL Profile that the Policy conforms to.

genericLicense.description: Property. States if one or more generic licenses apply, like Open Data (or other ecosystem-defined license).

dataAccessPrerequisites.description: Relationship. The conditions that the Data Consumer must fulfill to be given access to the data sets. Links to one or more DataAccessPrerequisite entities.

dataUsageConstraints.description: Relationship. The constraints that the Data Consumer contractually commits to respect when using the data sets. Links to one or more DataUsageConstraint entities.
